title: Sr. Business Systems Engineer - Application Development
description:
**The Opportunity**
Analyze moderately complex business problems to be solved with automated systems. Provide technical expertise in identifying, evaluating and developing systems and procedures that are cost effective and meet user requirements. Configure system settings and options; executes unit, integration and acceptance testing; and assists in creating specifications for systems to meet business requirements. Designs details of automated systems.
  
  
Avantor is looking for Sr. Business System Engineer - Application Development who can analyze moderately complex business problems to be solved with automated systems. Provide technical expertise in identifying, evaluating and developing systems and procedures that are cost effective and meet user requirements. Configure system settings and options, executes unit, integration and acceptance testing; and assists in creating specifications for systems to meet business requirements. Designs details of automated systems.
  
  
**MAJOR JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (List in order of importance)**

* Works with respective team members and/or management to deliver solutions according to requirements defined and prioritized by VWR’s business.
* Acts as a Developer between the quality assurance team, ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) team, DBAs, operations, and support team to meet milestones in a lean and agile manner.
* Ensure operational controls are maintained.
* Perform & report on operating control self-assessments.
* As part of a project team, performs design, build, implementation, unit tests, and code review.
* Translates functional requirements into conceptual and detailed designs; Provides estimates for development effort; Implements proof of concept, prototypes, and production-grade software; writes unit tests; fully documents code; and coordinates with testing requirements from QA/Test.
* As needed and according to agile development methodologies, participate in iterative development including sprint planning, daily scrum, release, and retrospective meetings.
* Supports VWR’s SharePoint and .NET Applications for major project implementations, enhancements, and break-fix requirements. Assists Operations and Support staff in trouble-shooting software issues as well as implementing bug fixes.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Design, build and test .NET solutions with basic. ChatGPT/Copilot and Claude. Document all system changes in line with the standard processes. Conduct Unit testing of configuration changes and drive integration /regression testing.
* Manage activities involved in delivering .NET applications by prioritizing workloads as well as providing guidance and direction to other team members. Oversee GNOC network team globally
* Mentor Network / GNOC technicians on problem solving and troubleshooting SharePoint related issues. Provide operational and technical training to team members.
* Maintain superior technical skills in an enterprise environment for managing SharePoint, Power Automate, Power BI technologies
* Analyze and report any Performance issues, recommend and implement improvements globally as needed. Act as Level-2/Level-3 for support issues.
* Provide innovative solutions.
* Help maintain accurate inventory of all applications maintained under management. Understands SharePoint architecture and support functions globally
* Understand VWR’s business model and how Infrastructure & Operations Support directly influences our capabilities to conduct daily business operations.
* Collaborate with IT Operations Team colleagues on best practice solutions
* Collaborate with all other Infrastructure & Operations Support Teams to ensure high systems availability, capacity and expected levels of performance.
* Practice consistent Change Management, Incident Management and Technology Management and in a professional and effective manner.
* Utilize VWR standard toolsets such as ServiceNow, JIRA and others to track, monitor, repair, and improve network services.
* Create high quality SharePoint and .NET documentation and drawings and practice disciplined version control Interact with third party network service providers in a professional manner, ensuring consistent

**QUALIFICATIONS (Education/Training, Experience and Certifications)**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* 5+ years of .NET development experience in a team environment
* 2+ years in an Agile/Scrum environment
* Prompt Engineering proficiency — ability to design, test, and optimize prompts for AI-assisted development
* API knowledge — design, integration, and consumption of RESTful/web APIs
* Experience with ChatGPT Codex and Claude Cowork for AI-assisted development
* Proficiency in at least one RDBMS (SQL Server, Oracle, etc.)
* Experience with version control (SVN or Git)
* Excel macros (VBA/VBS)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

**KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITIES (Those necessary to perform the job competently)**

* Design, build, test, and document .NET and SharePoint solutions end-to-end
* Translate business requirements into technical designs and effort estimates
* Lead unit testing, code reviews, and coordinate with QA for integration/regression testing
* Participate in sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives
* Act as Level-2/Level-3 escalation for SharePoint and .NET support issues
* Mentor junior/mid-level developers and GNOC technicians
* Maintain change management, incident management, and ServiceNow/JIRA workflows

**Added Advantage**

* UiPath (RPA) and Python scripting
* Bootstrap/web-based UI development
* Performance tuning (front-end and back-end)

title: Lead / Senior Systems Engineer - HPC Administrator
description:
We are looking for a
**Lead / Senior**
**Systems Engineer**
to handle HPC Administration tasks, keeping high-performance computing environments running smoothly, reliable, and well-supported for users.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Resolve HPC system issues to reduce downtime and performance impact
* Keep Linux systems stable through maintenance and troubleshooting
* Build and maintain monitoring systems for infrastructure health tracking
* Provide operational support and communicate with users on HPC inquiries
* Track and resolve incidents through ServiceNow ticket management
* Optimize performance by diagnosing, upgrading, and tuning HPC hardware
* Operate effectively in environments with limited documentation

**Requirements**

* 5-15 years of experience in systems engineering or HPC administration
* Strong expertise in Linux administration on RPM-based systems
* Proficient in kernel module compilation and debugging tools like strace, coredump, and tcpdump
* Experienced with monitoring platforms such as Zabbix, ELK, and Grafana, including Splunk dashboard configuration
* Knowledgeable in HPC hardware diagnostics, upgrades, and tuning for InfiniBand HCAs, Lustre/VAST/IBM storage, and Dell/HP servers
* Hands-on experience with job schedulers like Slurm or UGE/AGE

**Nice to have**

* Experience with cluster management platforms such as Bright Cluster Manager, xCAT, or IBM CSM
